{{DPS calculator}} This article is about calculating melee damage output. Melee damage is affected by the [[Equipment]] used, [[prayer]], [[Temporary skill boost|skill boosts]] and the [[monster]] being attacked. There are various methods by which players can increase their potential '''[[Melee]] damage'''. The effects of most equipped items can be seen in the [[Equipment Stats|stats window]] (labelled as Stab, Slash, Crush and Melee Strength). ==Calculating your melee damage output== ===Step one: Calculate the ''effective strength level''=== Effective level is affected by your current strength level multiplied by prayers used and skill level boosts. '''To calculate effective strength level:''' #(Strength level + Strength level boost) * prayer modifier #Round down to nearest integer #If you're calculating for: #*A player, +3 if they're using the aggressive attack style, or +1 if using controlled #*An NPC, +1 #+8 #Multiply by 1.1 if wearing full [[Void Knight equipment|melee void]] #Round down to nearest integer '''Strength Level boost:''' {{main|Temporary skill boost}}
{{:Temporary skill boost/Strength}}
'''Prayer Multiplier:''' {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" |Prayer |- |[[Burst of Strength]] |1.05 |- |[[Superhuman Strength]] |1.10 |- |[[Ultimate Strength]] |1.15 |- |[[Chivalry]] |1.18 |- |[[Piety]] |1.23 |} ===Step two: Calculate the ''maximum hit''=== The maximum hit is the largest hit you can possibly do with the current setup. It can be tested by using the Combat Dummy in a Player Owned House. '''To calculate your maximum hit:''' #Effective strength level #Multiply by (Equipment Strength bonus + 64) #*The Equipment Strength bonus can be found in the Equipment Stats window under 'Other bonuses'. #Add 320 #Divide by 640 #Round down to nearest integer #Multiply by target-specific gear bonus #*If slaying monsters on task while wearing a black mask or slayer helm, gear bonus is 7/6. If killing undead monsters while wearing a salve amulet, gear bonus is 7/6, or 1.2 if using salve amulet (e) or (ei). Note that these two bonuses DO NOT stack. #*If attacking another player who has the Protect from Melee prayer active, multiply by 6/10. #Round down to nearest integer ===Step three: Calculate the ''effective attack level''=== Effective level is affected by your current attack level multiplied by prayers used and skill level boosts. '''To calculate your effective attack level:''' #(Attack level + Attack level boost) * prayer modifier #Round down to nearest integer #If you're calculating for: #*A player, +3 if they're using the accurate attack style, or +1 if using controlled #*An NPC, +1 #+8 #Multiply by 1.1 if wearing void #Round down to nearest integer '''Attack Level boost:''' {{main|Temporary skill boost}}
{{:Temporary skill boost/Attack}}
'''Prayer Multiplier:''' {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" |Prayer |- |[[Clarity of Thought]] |1.05 |- |[[Improved Reflexes]] |1.10 |- |[[Incredible Reflexes]] |1.15 |- |[[Chivalry]] |1.15 |- |[[Piety]] |1.20 |} ===Step four: Calculate the ''Attack roll''=== #Effective attack level * (Equipment Attack bonus + 64) #Multiply by target-specific gear bonus #Round down to nearest integer The Equipment Attack bonus can be found in the Equipment Stats window, and is labelled Stab, Slash, Crush. Use the value of whichever attack type you are using. Gear bonus is the same as in Step Two. ===Step five: Calculate the ''effective defence level''=== The effective defence level is only used for calculating the defence roll for players, it is not used for monsters. It is affected by the player's defence level multiplied by prayers used and skill level boosts. '''To calculate your effective defence level:''' #(Defence level + Defence level boost) * prayer bonus #Round down to nearest integer #+3 if the player is using the defensive attack style, or +1 if using controlled #+8 ===Step six: Calculate the ''Defence roll''=== To calculate a [[Monsters|monster's]] defence roll, use the formula: \text{Def roll} =(\text{Target Defence level}+9)*(\text{Target Style Defence Bonus}+64) Target's Defence level is denoted by a shield icon on the target's wiki page. To calculate a [[player|player's]] defence roll, use the formula: \text{Def roll} =\text {Effective Defence}*(\text{Target Style Defence Bonus}+64) Target's style defence bonus refers to its stab, slash or crush defensive stats, depending on the attack type used. ===Step seven: Calculate the ''hit chance''=== '''If Attack Roll > Defence roll:''' \text{Hit Chance} =1-\frac{\text{Def roll} + 2}{2*(\text{Atk roll}+1)} '''Else''' \text{Hit Chance} =\frac{\text{Atk roll}}{2*(\text{Def roll}+1)} ===Step eight: Calculate the ''melee damage output''=== \text{Average damage per attack} = \text{Hit Chance} * \Biggl(\frac{\text{Maximum hit}}{2}+\frac{\text{1}}{\text{Maximum hit}+1}\Biggr) A small amount is added equal to the inverse of the maximum hit. This is because if you roll a 0 on a successful attack it will be changed to a 1. To calculate the average damage per second (dps), divide the average damage per attack by the attack speed of the weapon in seconds. {{Reflist}} {{Combat Mechanics}}
